caption: The drawing depicts a wooden frame constructed from light brown and dark brown wood, assembled with visible screws at the top corners and sides. The frame has two thicker, rectangular vertical side supports and two horizontal beams, one at the top and one at the midpoint, both also brown. Within the main section of the frame, there are ten cylindrical objects arranged in two rows, each row holding five cylinders. The cylinders are vertically oriented, colored in light blue with darker blue shading to indicate depth and roundness, and each has a conical or pointed tip at the bottom. The background is a plain off-white or beige, and there is a subtle shadow cast to the right side and below the object, suggesting a light source coming from the left. A thin, hand-drawn rectangle borders the entire composition, leaving a wide margin between the object and the edge of the paper.
title: Rack with Candle Molds
